objective: Preserve the current skimage Lewiner marching-cubes contour semantics while allowing certified empty-space pruning by running MC on disjoint cell blocks of one global canonical lattice and welding shared edge vertices.

block_contract.cell_partition: blocks partition cube cells without overlap; adjacent block sample grids overlap by exactly one corner plane
block_contract.vertex_identity: derive the unique global canonical lattice edge containing each emitted MC vertex; weld by unordered global edge endpoints
block_contract.exact_zero_policy: fixtures exclude exact-zero lattice corners; production exact-zero handling remains a separately typed policy
block_contract.block_skip: a block with sampled min>=0 or max<=0 emits no MC triangles; this is equivalence to dense sampled-lattice MC, not a continuous-field absence certificate

frozen_gates: canonical global lattice-edge vertex-key set equals dense Lewiner MC
canonical face set in edge-key identities equals dense Lewiner MC
zero nonmanifold edges introduced by block welding
all block-boundary shared vertices weld to one global edge identity
claim_boundary: X2 establishes sampled-lattice blockwise equivalence only. Continuous-field completeness still comes from C0/adaptive discovery; source fidelity still requires VF11/Stage13.
